versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the whisper-identity skill.
- Provides agents with real, routable IPv6 /128 addresses for network identity and stable egress.
- Enables public, verifiable identity via DNSSEC and RDAP—no account or installation needed for verification.
- Requires a Whisper API key to assign an IPv6 identity and set up egress.
- Full documentation available at https://whisper.online/docs.
